issues.description: Entire compiled script is shipped in every compile RPC response, inflating payload and memory
issues.detail: compile_notebook always reads script_content and returns it inline, even when the user never clicks Download. For large pipelines this duplicates the file in memory and over the wire on every compile. Replace with a lazy on-demand download endpoint invoked only on click.

issues.description: open() lacks explicit utf-8 encoding and error handling, risking failure on non-ASCII or missing files
issues.detail: open(script_path) relies on the platform default encoding and has no try/except. On non-UTF-8 locales or containers with LANG=C, non-ASCII content raises UnicodeDecodeError; a missing or relocated script breaks the entire compile RPC. Use encoding='utf-8' and guard the read.

issues.description: Download icon lacks button semantics and keyboard accessibility
issues.detail: GetAppIcon is rendered as a bare SVG with onClick but no role='button', tabIndex, aria-label, or keyboard handler. Screen reader and keyboard users cannot trigger the download. Wrap in an IconButton or button to match the sibling anchor's affordances.

issues.description: Download icon renders even when compiledContent is missing, producing a silent no-op
issues.detail: The icon is rendered unconditionally in the success branch, but handleDownloadClick early-returns when props.compiledContent is undefined. With older backends or stripped fields, users see a clickable control that does nothing with no feedback. Hide or disable the icon when compiledContent is absent.

issues.description: Fallback filename 'pipeline.kale.py' is mostly dead code and may mislead users
issues.detail: split('/').pop() only yields empty for trailing slashes, so the fallback rarely triggers. Worse, if the actual artifact is a yaml/tarball, the .py extension misnames the download. Derive from pipeline_name or the real path, or omit the generic fallback.

issues.description: Downloaded payload is the intermediate .py source, not the actual compiled pipeline package
issues.detail: The UI labels this 'Download compiled file', but the backend returns script_path content rather than package_path (the real compiled artifact from kfputils.compile_pipeline). This contradicts the PR's stated intent and confuses users; either download package_path or clarify naming in UI and variables.

synthesis.summary: The panel unanimously agrees the feature works for the happy path but has consistent issues. The backend ships the entire compiled script in every RPC response, reads it without explicit utf-8 encoding or error handling, and may be returning the wrong artifact (intermediate .py source vs. compiled package). On the frontend, the download trigger is a bare SVG without button semantics or keyboard support, and renders even when content is absent, producing silent no-ops. Filename fallback handling is minor but worth tightening. No P0 blockers, but the payload, encoding, and a11y issues should land before merge.
